pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:0.5: Ime kho pan' ayyāyo sattarasa saṃghādisesā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako bhikkhunīsaṃghassa uddositaṃ datvā kālaṃkato hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.4: eko assaddho appasanno eko saddho pasanno,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.6: atha kho so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.8: evaṃ vutte so saddho pasanno taṃ assaddhaṃ appasannaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.11: dutiyam pi kho so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.13: atha kho so saddho pasanno taṃ assaddhaṃ appasannaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.16: tatiyam pi kho so assaddho . . . taṃ bhājāmā
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.19: sace mayhaṃ bhavissati aham pi bhikkhunīsaṃghassa dassāmīti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.20: taṃ assaddhaṃ appasannaṃ etad avoca: bhājāmā
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.22: atha kho so uddosito tehi bhājiyamāno tassa assaddhassa appasannassa pāpuṇāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.23: atha kho so assaddho appasanno bhikkhuniyo upasaṃkamitvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.25: evaṃ vutte Thullanandā bhikkhunī taṃ purisaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.26: māyyo evaṃ avaca, tumhākaṃ pitunā bhikkhunīsaṃghassa dinno 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.30: evaṃ vutte Thullanandā bhikkhunī te mahāmatte etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.31: api n' ayyo tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā sakkhiṃ ṭhapayitvā dānaṃ diyyamānan ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.33: saccaṃ kho ayyā āhā 'ti taṃ uddositaṃ bhikkhunīsaṃghassa akaṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.34: atha kho so puriso parājito ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.36: kathaṃ hi nāma amhākaṃ uddositaṃ acchindāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.37: Thullanandā bhikkhunī mahāmattānaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.39: atha kho so puriso daṇḍiko bhikkhunūpassayassa avidūre ājīvikaseyyaṃ kārāpetvā ājīvike uyyojesi:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.41: Thullanandā bhikkhunī mahāmattānaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.44: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo uddositaṃ acchindāpesuṃ, dutiyam pi daṇḍāpesuṃ, tatiyam pi bandhāpesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.46: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.48: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Thullanandā ussayavādikā viharissatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.49: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.50: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī ussayavādikā viharatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.53: hi nāma bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī ussayavādikā viharissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.56.1: yā pana bhikkhunī ussayavādikā vihareyya gahapatinā vā gahapatiputtena vā dāsena vā kammakārena vā antamaso samaṇaparibbājakenāpi, ayaṃ bhikkhunī paṭhamāpattikaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṃghādisesan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:2.1.16: bhikkhuñ ca bhikkhuniñ ca sikkhamānañ ca sāmaṇerañ ca sāmaṇeriñ ca ṭhapetvā yo koci paribbājakasamāpanno.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:2.1.17: aṭṭaṃ karissāmīti dutiyaṃ vā pariyesati gacchati vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:2.1.26: saṃgho 'va tassā āpattiyā mānattaṃ deti mūlāya paṭikassati abbheti, na sambahulā na ekā bhikkhunī, tena vuccati saṃghādiseso 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:2.1.27: tass' eva āpattinikāyassa nāma kammaṃ adhivacanaṃ, tena pi vuccati saṃghādiseso 'ti. ||1||
